name: Backlog Comisiones
query:
SELECT
    si.name                                        AS "Factura:Link/Sales Invoice:160",
    si.customer                                    AS "Cliente:Link/Customer:220",
    si.posting_date                                AS "Fecha:Date:100",

    /* Sucursales desde items (concat únicas) limitadas al subárbol seleccionado */
    COALESCE((
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sii.cost_center ORDER BY sii.cost_center SEPARATOR ', ')
        FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        INNER JOIN `tabCost Center` cc_item ON cc_item.name = sii.cost_center
        INNER JOIN `tabCost Center` cc_sel
            ON cc_sel.name = %(cost_center)s
           AND cc_item.lft BETWEEN cc_sel.lft AND cc_sel.rgt
        WHERE sii.parent = si.name
    ), '')                                         AS "Sucursal(es):Data:240",

    si.base_grand_total                            AS "Importe Factura:Currency:120",

    /* Cobro OK: SOLO totalmente pagada */
    CASE
      WHEN si.status = 'Paid' THEN 1
      WHEN COALESCE(si.outstanding_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END                                            AS "Cobro OK:Check:90",

    /* Indicador y lista de vendedores dentro del subárbol seleccionado */
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabSales Team` st
        INNER JOIN `tabSales Person` sp_item ON sp_item.name = st.sales_person
        INNER JOIN `tabSales Person` sp_sel
            ON sp_sel.name = %(sales_person)s
           AND sp_item.lft BETWEEN sp_sel.lft AND sp_sel.rgt
        WHERE st.parent = si.name
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                            AS "Vendedores OK:Check:90",

    COALESCE((
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT st.sales_person ORDER BY st.sales_person SEPARATOR ', ')
        FROM `tabSales Team` st
        INNER JOIN `tabSales Person` sp_item ON sp_item.name = st.sales_person
        INNER JOIN `tabSales Person` sp_sel
            ON sp_sel.name = %(sales_person)s
           AND sp_item.lft BETWEEN sp_sel.lft AND sp_sel.rgt
        WHERE st.parent = si.name
    ), '')                                         AS "Vendedores (en subárbol):Data:260"

FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

    /* Debe existir al menos un ítem en el subárbol de la Sucursal seleccionada */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        INNER JOIN `tabCost Center` cc_item ON cc_item.name = sii.cost_center
        INNER JOIN `tabCost Center` cc_sel
            ON cc_sel.name = %(cost_center)s
           AND cc_item.lft BETWEEN cc_sel.lft AND cc_sel.rgt
        WHERE sii.parent = si.name
    )

    /* Debe existir al menos un vendedor en el subárbol del Sales Person seleccionado */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabSales Team` st
        INNER JOIN `tabSales Person` sp_item ON sp_item.name = st.sales_person
        INNER JOIN `tabSales Person` sp_sel
            ON sp_sel.name = %(sales_person)s
           AND sp_item.lft BETWEEN sp_sel.lft AND sp_sel.rgt
        WHERE st.parent = si.name
    )

    /* Excluir clientes sin comisión (child de Comisiones Settings) */
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabClientes Sin Comision` ex
        WHERE ex.parenttype  = 'Comisiones Settings'
          AND ex.parent      = 'Comisiones Settings'
          AND ex.parentfield = 'clientes_sin_comision'
          AND ex.customer    = si.customer
          AND (ex.start_date IS NULL OR si.posting_date >= ex.start_date)
          AND (ex.end_date   IS NULL OR si.posting_date <= ex.end_date)
    )

    /* Excluir SI ya incluidas en una OPC aprobada */
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabComision LLCS` c
        INNER JOIN `tabOrden de Pago Comisiones` opc
                ON opc.name = c.parent AND opc.docstatus = 1
        WHERE c.sales_invoice_id = si.name
    )

ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC, si.name DESC;

name: Pagos OPC - Resumen
query:
SELECT
    opc.name                                   AS "OPC:Link/Orden de Pago Comisiones:220",
    opc.desde                                  AS "Desde:Date:110",
    opc.hasta_fecha                            AS "Hasta:Date:110",
    opc.confirmacion_de_pago                   AS "Estado:Data:140",
    COALESCE(opc.monto_total, 0)               AS "Total:Currency:140",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabComision LLCS` c WHERE c.parent = opc.name)
                                               AS "Filas:Int:80"
FROM `tabOrden de Pago Comisiones` opc
WHERE opc.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY opc.hasta_fecha DESC, opc.name DESC
LIMIT 200

name: Pagos OPC - Por Sucursal
query:
SELECT
  x.cc_label                              AS "Sucursal (Cost Center):Data:220",
  x.total_commission                      AS "Total Comisiones:Currency:140",
  x.opc_count                             AS "# OPCs:Int:80",
  x.invoice_count                         AS "# Facturas:Int:100"
FROM (
  SELECT
    IFNULL(si.cost_center,'TOTAL')        AS cc_label,
    ROUND(SUM(c.total_comision), 2)       AS total_commission,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.parent)              AS opc_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.sales_invoice_id)    AS invoice_count
  FROM `tabComision LLCS` c
  INNER JOIN `tabOrden de Pago Comisiones` opc ON opc.name = c.parent AND opc.docstatus = 1
  INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = c.sales_invoice_id AND si.docstatus = 1
  WHERE si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
    AND si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
  GROUP BY si.cost_center WITH ROLLUP
) x
ORDER BY (x.cc_label = 'TOTAL'), x.cc_label;
